{{Term/Store|Blupee|Blupees|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/><ref name="TotK Hyrule Compendium"/> also known as '''Glowing Blue Bunnies''',{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6"/><ref name="TotK Rumor Mill"/> are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Blupee}}
Otherwise resembling [[Rabbit]]s, Blupees are luminescent blue beings with a face resembling a barn owl's and golden wreaths in the place of ears.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They flee when they notice [[Link]], eventually disappearing in a flash of light. While their origins are mysterious, they are known to collected [[Rupee]]s.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/><ref name="CaC 157"/> As a result, they drop [[Rupee]]s when struck by an [[Arrow]], a [[Remote Bomb]], a thrown [[Boomerang]], or any melee [[Weapon]]; though they cannot be killed.<ref>{{Cite|The Blupee is a rare glowing creature that drops rupees when you shoot it with an arrow.|Adventure Log|BotW}}</ref> Blupees can be found in forests all over [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]].

Several Blupees gather on [[Satori Mountain]] every night the [[Lord of the Mountain]] appears. Blupees share many characteristics with the Lord of the Mountain, whose face resembles a pair of Blupees. Like the Lord of the Mountain, Blupees appear to be mystical rather than natural creatures, being referred to as spirits.<ref name="CaC 157"/>

The ''[[Rumor Mill: Volume 6]]'' details a hunter's encounter with a Blupee.<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6"/> While returning from a hunt, he saw a light moving nearby.<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6 2"/> He fired an Arrow at it, and when he investigated, he found Rupees.<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6 3"/> Following this, the hunter would shoot at the light whenever he saw it and find Rupees, which resulted in him becoming rich.<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6 4"/> [[Traysi]] claims that this light was a Blupee, and she encourages her readers to obtain Rupees using this method.<ref name="BotW Rumor Mill: Volume 6 5"/>

During the "[[Legendary Rabbit Trial]]" [[Side Quest]], [[Peeks]] asks Link to show him a [[Picture]] of a Blupee.<ref name="BotW Peeks"/> When Link shows Peeks the Picture, he will be amazed by how beautiful it is.<ref name="BotW Peeks 2"/> As a reward, he gives Link a [[Silver Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|...Oh! And here's a litle thank-you gift! Peeks didn't forget!|Peeks|BotW}}</ref> Afterwards, Peeks speculates that Blupees sparkle because of all the Rupees they carry, and he wonders if they make all the Rupees found in Hyrule Kingdom.<ref name="BotW Peeks 3"/>

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Blupee}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
Blupees commonly appear close to [[Cave]]s throughout [[Hyrule]]. If they spot [[Link]], they will run away or travel toward the entrance of a nearby cave before vanishing. They also appear after [[Bubbulfrog]]s are defeated.

Blupees cannot be found in the [[Sky]], nor in the [[Depths]] with the exception of [[Blupee Burrow]] in the [[Hyrule Ridge Depths]]. The Blupee Burrow is home to a [[Cherry-Blossom Tree]] around which Blupees gather.
